entries.intent: lookup:may i open the radiator cap when the engine is hot?

response.text: No. The manual warns never to open the radiator cap when the engine is hot: pressurised coolant can boil, expand, and spurt out, causing severe burns. Allow the engine to cool before any coolant work.

entries.intent: lookup:what is the drive-chain free play specification?

response.text: The manual specifies 35–40 mm drive-chain free play, measured as the difference between its upward and downward positions at the tightest point. It warns that slackness outside the limit can cause slippage and wear, and that wheel alignment must be checked after adjustment.

entries.intent: lookup:what is the clutch lever free play specification?

response.text: The manual specifies 9–11 mm at the clutch lever ball end. Check or adjust with the engine cold; if the desired free play cannot be achieved or clutch slip is suspected, keep positive free play and visit a service centre.

entries.intent: lookup:how do i check the engine oil level?

response.text: Keep the motorcycle upright on a level surface, idle it from cold for 2–3 minutes, stop it, then wait 2–3 minutes before reading the sight glass. The level should be near MAX; do not overfill above MAX.

entries.intent: lookup:how long may i hold the starter switch?

response.text: Do not hold the electric start switch longer than 5 seconds in one attempt. If the engine does not start, release it and wait about 5 seconds before trying again. The manual cautions that holding it too long can drain the battery.
